notes.title: (This isn't your typical) PATCH!!!
notes.content:
Patches are mostly about fixes, but not this one! We added some polish, sure, but it's secondary. Mostly achievement tweaks and some minor fixes. No, this is about giving you what you asked.

[h3]With this patch, Liberated now supports a wider array of resolutions, and the AZERTY keyboard scheme![/h3]

Even if you want to play the game in ultra widescreen, now it's not a problem. You don't have to try to force it or apply some mod. Liberated natively supports screens up to [b]32:9[/b]!

Is there anything else you'd like to see added? We'll do our best to deliver. Leave us a comment below. Also, did you like our game? We'll be grateful if you leave a Steam review!

Until next time. [u][b]Keep fighting![/b][/u]

Obligatory cold one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34782333/5b6690992de30b2e62fef5820bf825c4588425c2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Did you get 2 FREE story chapters?
notes.content:
With Liberated coming to PC, we wanted to give you as much value as possible, so we expanded it with 2 additional epilogue chapters! Download them for free and see what happened in the aftermath of the story.

[h3]For the Homeland[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34782333/282d91029752160f1228ecb7090899609514934c.jpg[/img]

The first new chapter, titled "For the Homeland", lets you live a day in the life of a paid internet troll and steer the public opinion in the 'right' direction. It's a chance to look at the system from a new perspective – of a guy whose daily job is to keep it running. He doesn't shoot people, although he certainly can destroy them.

[h3]Glory to the Heroes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34782333/f4cad61b4a652413fab73e81b38a6622f68f63e6.jpg[/img]

The second chapter, titled „Glory to the Heroes,” explores how the general narrative about what happened is twisted by the media. It's another point of view that we wanted to show your, because the mainstream news outlets pretty much shape our reality. 

You can download these chapters as soon as you get the game, but they'll unlock only after you beat the story. Otherwise it wouldn't make much sense.

After you play, we'd love it if you left us your review on Steam. Have fun!

notes.title: PC PREMIERE INFODROP: Trailer, release date & FREE DLC
notes.content:
[b]BIG news, y'all![/b] LIBERATED will land on your PC on July 30, and full of NEW STUFF to make the experience more yummy than ever. 

Here's exactly what you can expect.

[previewyoutube=rmXNeJEZWE8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]1. Boost in presentation.[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ultra HD resolution support. (4K and up)
[*] Ultra widescreen support.
[*] High refresh rate support. (144Hz and up)
[*] High-res textures.
[*] Enhanced lighting.
[/list]
[h2]2. Boost in gameplay.[/h2]

Support for Keyboard & Mouse + Gamepads.
Various improvements to the game flow.

[h2]3. TWO FREE DLC CHAPTERS![/h2]

[u]FOR THE HOMELAND[/u] tells the story of a low-level official tasked with directing the public discourse online. As a ‘paid troll,’ he destroys the lives and careers of targeted people while treating it like a nine-to-five job.

[u]GLORY TO THE HEROES[/u] shows how the government and the media twist the narrative about the events presented in the base game. 

[h2]4. Full English voice-over to max your immersion.[/h2]

Here's what core Nintendo press had to say about Liberated.

[list]
[*] “An atmospheric, absorbing treat” - [b]8/10, Nintendo Life[/b]
[*] “More than just a game” - [b]8/10, NintendoSoup[/b]
[*] “An incredibly well-crafted game that executes both story and gameplay excellently” - [b]9/10, Pure Nintendo[/b]
[*] “A standout title, both experimental and engrossing” - [b]9/10, Nintendo Enthusiast[/b]
[*] “Fine example of how games can enhance storytelling” - [b]84%, Switchaboo[/b]
[/list]

Your PC version of the game will come enriched and with extra polish. We can't wait to let you play it!

notes.title: Coming to Steam in July – enhanced for PC
notes.content:
Alright now, it’s official — the news you’ve been waiting for: 
[h3][b]Liberated is hitting Steam in July![/b][/h3]

With the Switch launch behind us, we’re able to take some extra time for a PC edition worthy of the platform. Liberated is coming to PC with new features and support, including:

[list]
[*] Full English voice-overs
[*] High-res textures
[*] Enhanced lighting
[*] Ultra HD resolution support (4K and up)
[*] Ultra widescreen support
[*] High refresh rate support (144Hz and up)
[*] Support for Keyboard & Mouse + Gamepads
[/list]

[previewyoutube=i3UUzXglN1o;full][/previewyoutube]

If you already own Liberated on Switch we have great news for you too: voice-over support will be heading your way in a free update along with further performance updates and fixes. 
Dear friends, we are very excited.

[h3][b]Play the In-Development Demo[/b][/h3]
To celebrate the big PC news (and because a lot of folks asked for it) we’re making our PAX Showfloor demo available to you again for a limited-time. [b]This demo does not showcase voice overs and most recent technical developments[/b], but it should give you a pretty good idea of what to expect. Enjoy, your feedback helps us build a better game!

Remember to Wishlist and Follow Liberated on Steam, and join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/liberatedgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/LiberatedGame]Twitter[/url], [url=http://instagram.com/liberated_game/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Liberated/475782]Gamejolt[/url]!

notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
[h3]We’re thrilled to join the Steam Game Festival: Spring Edition! [/h3]
[b]Play the demo and get your hands on Liberated for the first time between March 18-23.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/875310/Liberated/ 

[h3]WHAT’S IN THE BOX?[/h3]
The demo is a selection of action scenes from the first two chapters of the game. It was originally made for exclusive press events at GDC and EGX London, but since we can’t be there with you in person — this is… [i]actually even cooler![/i]

[b]A few things to note:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]We really recommend playing with a gamepad[/b], M+KB controls are supported but still need work

[*] [b]You’ll jump around the comic a lot[/b], you’ll get a tease of the story and a good sense for the gameplay

[*] [b]Story will play a much bigger role[/b] in the final experience on release

[*] [b]All planned languages are supported[/b] in the demo, and it's a lot: English, French, German, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese
[/list]

We’re super excited to share the demo with you, but it comes with a teeny tiny asterisk. [i]Liberated is still work in progress[/i], so you may encounter glitches or performance issues. Rest assured we’ll iron them out before release. Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/875310/discussions/0/1871748878349874194/]Demo F.A.Q[/url] for more info.



[h3]WE'RE COUNTING ON YOUR FEEDBACK[/h3]
[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/875310/discussions/]Join the discussion![/url][/b]
We’re making this game for YOU, so your feedback will be invaluable. Share your thoughts: tell us what you liked and what you didn’t. And if you run into technical troubles, let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/875310/discussions/0/1871748878349923558/]Technical Thread[/url].

Also, fill out [b][url=http://bit.ly/LiberatedDEMOthoughts]THE SURVEY[/url][/b] once you've completed the demo — you’ll get some Liberated goodies in return after the event!

We’ll be here chatting and taking notes. Have fun!

notes.title: You woke up in a safer tomorrow!
notes.content:
[b]From: 82517@themis.civ
Subject: You woke up in a safer tomorrow![/b]

Dear Citizen,

[i]Great news![/i] You are now part of the Citizen Credit System. 
CCS grants you (or takes away) points for every action. This way, you can see EXACTLY how much value you bring to our society.

How does it work, exactly?
[list][*] [b]HIGH CCS[/b] will grant you a badge of Model Citizen, and unlock exclusive social benefits.

[*] [b]NORMAL CCS [/b]means that you have nothing to worry about. But remember: you can always do better!

[*] [b]LOW CCS [/b]is a symptom of social retraction. You will be prompted to readapt to your community.
[/list]
We've made self-improvement easy and measurable! Moreover, this fantastic new tool lets us deal with anti-social individuals to ensure your comfort and safety.

Share your appreciation on social media: https://www.facebook.com/liberatedgame/ (+10 CCS bonus will be granted.)

Let me personally wish you a great day!
[i]Automated Information Dispenser[/i]
